BatchCreateResourceTags.name: BatchCreateResourceTags
BatchCreateResourceTags.summary: Adding or Deleting Tags in Batches
BatchCreateResourceTags.description: This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a specified resource. TMS needs to use this API to manage tags of resources in batches. A resource can have a maximum of 10 tags.

BindGlobalEips.name: BindGlobalEips
BindGlobalEips.summary: Binding Global EIPs to a Connect Gateway
BindGlobalEips.description: This API is used to bind global EIPs to a connect gateway.

CreateConnectGateway.description: This API is used to create a connect gateway.

CreateGlobalDcGateway.name: CreateGlobalDcGateway
CreateGlobalDcGateway.description: This API is used to create a global DC gateway that can be attached to an enterprise router.

CreateHostedDirectConnect.name: CreateHostedDirectConnect
CreateHostedDirectConnect.description: This API is used by partners to create hosted connections for their users. The creator must have the partner qualification and have an operations connection.

CreatePeerLink.name: CreatePeerLink
CreatePeerLink.description: This API is used to add a peer link between a global DC gateway and an enterprise router or another global DC gateway.

CreateResourceTag.name: CreateResourceTag
CreateResourceTag.description: This API is used to add a tag to a resource. - A resource can have up to 10 tags. - This API is idempotent. - If a tag has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.

CreateVifPeerDetection.summary: Creating a Connectivity Detection Task for a Virtual Interface Peer
CreateVifPeerDetection.description: This API is used to create a connectivity detection task for a virtual interface peer to test the connectivity of the remote gateway.

DeleteVifPeer.name: DeleteVifPeer
DeleteVifPeer.description: This API is used to delete a virtual interface. The virtual interface must contain at least one peer. The last peer cannot be deleted. This API is available only in regions that support IPv6. To use this API, contact customer service.

DeleteVifPeerDetection.name: DeleteVifPeerDetection
DeleteVifPeerDetection.summary: Deleting a Connectivity Detection Task for a Virtual Interface Peer
DeleteVifPeerDetection.description: This API is used to delete a connectivity detection task if you no longer need it.

ListDirectConnects.name: ListDirectConnects
ListDirectConnects.description: This API is used to query all direct connections created by a tenant.

ListGdgwRouteTables.name: ListGdgwRouteTables

ListGdgwRouteTables.description: This API is used to query the route tables for a global DC gateway.

ListGlobalDcGateways.name: ListGlobalDcGateways
ListGlobalDcGateways.summary: Querying the Global DC Gateway List
ListGlobalDcGateways.description: This API is used to query the global DC gateway list. Pagination query is recommended. The **marker** and **limit** parameters are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.

ListGlobalEips.name: ListGlobalEips
ListGlobalEips.summary: Querying the Global EIPs Bound to a Connect Gateway

ListProjectTags.description: This API is used to query the tags of a resource type in a specific project. TMS uses this API to list tags created by a tenant to facilitate tag creation and resource filtering on the console.
